name: Spatio-Temporal Reasoning Benchmark for LLMs
description: Spatio-Temporal Reasoning Benchmark for LLMs This repository contains a benchmarking framework for evaluating Large Language Models on spatio-temporal reasoning tasks. The benchmark automatically generates evaluation cases from templates and domain scenarios, retrieving ground truth from Wikidata to assess LLM factual correctness and reasoning consistency. What's included: Template-based test case generators for six reasoning tasks: Birthplace Historical Sovereignty (BHS), Countries Organizations Members At Year (COMA), Countries To Cross (CTC), Historical Countries of City (HCC), Presidential Successor (PS), and Sum of Years Person in Role (SYPR) Wikidata SPARQL queries and data extraction scripts for building ground truth Evaluation pipeline with multiple matching strategies (exact string, fuzzy matching, LLM-as-judge) Results and analysis for 4 local LLMs (4B–27B parameters) Use this to: Evaluate your own LLMs on spatio-temporal reasoning Benchmark factual consistency across time and space Compare evaluation metrics (exact vs. fuzzy vs. semantic matching) Extend the framework with additional reasoning tasks Requirements: Python 3.8+, Wikidata SPARQL endpoint access, local LLM inference setup
